description: EE1: Imposter switching in opposite a healthy foe during a turn. Setup: Chansey's Memento faints it (p2's right position keeps the fainted Chansey). The turn: Pelipper switches out for Imposter Ditto in p1's right position; the foe opposite it is Garchomp (`side.foe.active[0]`), so Ditto transforms at once (the switch comes before Garchomp's Swords Dance, so no stages are copied), then Garchomp raises its Attack.
